bill.title: A BILL for an Act to create and enact chapter 44-04.1 of the North Dakota Century Code, relating to prohibiting agencies from entering nondisclosure agreements concerning data centers and industrial projects; to provide a penalty; to provide an effective date; and to provide an expiration date.

posted_text:
🏢 ND SB 2406 — North Dakota Could Block New Data Centers – Here’s Why

North Dakota is considering a law that would stop state agencies from locking up information about new data centers and industrial projects. Currently, developers can sign agreements with the state that keep details about projects – like energy use or water needs – secret. This bill would prevent agencies from entering these kinds of nondisclosure agreements, meaning developers would have to share information with the public. ...
